create_model_free_transformer: create a FreeTransformer model with num_tokens, dim, heads, and latent_bits for autoregressive generation with KL regularization
run_training_loop: run a training loop with gradient accumulation, Adam optimizer, and periodic validation on enwik8 text data
generate_text_samples: generate text samples from the FreeTransformer model using prompts, sequence length, and latent indices
build_text_sampler_dataset: build a TextSamplerDataset that yields random subsequences from a tensor of byte data for sequence modeling
decode_token_sequences: decode integer token sequences into readable ASCII strings for model output inspection
